defs.def: an opening in the wall or roof of a building, car, etc., usually covered with glass, that allows light and air to come in and people to see out; the glass in a window 窗；窗户；窗口；窗玻璃

ex.s: Emily awoke to a gentle knock on her car window.
ex.t: Emily被轻轻的敲车窗声唤醒。

ex.s: Flowers are everywhere-hanging baskets, window boxes, and planters-just what you imagine in an attractive English market town.
ex.t: 鲜花随处可见——吊篮、窗台花箱和花盆——正是你想象中迷人的英国集市小镇的样子。

ex.s: Mrs Hill’s front window faced Mr and Mrs Green’s house across the street.
ex.t: 希尔太太家的前窗正对着街对面格林夫妇的房子。

ex.s: Suddenly, the man jumped through an open window into the house.
ex.t: 突然，那个男人从一扇开着的窗户跳进屋里。

ex.s: Grabbing a branch from a cut-down tree, he jumped in through the window.
ex.t: 他抓起一根砍倒的树的树枝，从窗户跳了进去。

ex.s: The man stood up in a panic, then ran through the house toward the window and jumped out.
ex.t: 那名男子惊慌地站起来，然后跑过屋子冲向窗户跳了出去。

ex.s: Neighbors will bring me freshly made cheese and will come to my door to ___27___ me to close the window in my car when rain is coming.
ex.t: 邻居会给我送来新做的奶酪，快下雨时还会上门____我关上车窗。

ex.s: Awake from a short sleep in her chair, my grandmother ran her fingers through her wavy white hair, looked out her window at the blue sky, and asked me what I would wish for if I had just one wish.
ex.t: 祖母在椅子上小睡醒来，用手指捋了捋花白的卷发，望着窗外的蓝天，问我如果只有一个愿望，我会许什么愿。

ex.s: A noise at a window caught my attention, so I entered it.
ex.t: 窗户处的声音引起了我的注意，于是我走了进去。

ex.s: The broken window glass was the likely answer.
ex.t: 破碎的窗户玻璃很可能是答案。

ex.s: They promised to fix the window.
ex.t: 他们承诺修好窗户。

ex.s: I wiped the dirt from the window to get a better look inside.
ex.t: 我擦去窗户上的灰尘，好更清楚地看到里面。

ex.s: As my eyes rested on them, I felt as though I were looking through a window into my own past.
ex.t: 当我的目光停留在它们上面时，我觉得仿佛透过一扇窗户望进了自己的过去。

ex.s: As he was ___25___ that it would be too warm, he ___26___ it out on the table near an open window.
ex.t: 由于担心____25____会太热，他____26____把它放在靠近一扇开着的窗户的桌子上。

ex.s: Recently，I took a trip home by train．I got a seat opposite a middle-aged man with sharp eyes，who kept____1____a young woman in a window seat with a little boy on her lap．The woman's eye fell on the man's face，and she immediately looked down and____2____her scarf．
ex.t: 最近我坐火车回老家．我对面坐着一位目光锐利的中年男子他一直在____1____盯着窗边座位上一个抱着小孩的年轻女士看．那位女士的目光落在男士脸上她立刻低下头并____2____围紧了围巾．

ex.s: But our insisting it’s   45   a window has kept them from   46   millions of requests to open the door.
ex.t: 但我们坚持说它是一扇窗户，使得他们免于收到数百万个开门的请求。

ex.s: One day they’ll   47   and discover that everything they’ve always known about windows is a   48  .I wonder if   49   should always tell the truth no matter the   50  .
ex.t: 有一天他们会____47____并发现他们一直所知的关于窗户的一切都是____48____谎言。我想知道我们是否____49____应该无论如何都讲真话，无论____50____如何。

ex.s: Her voice was soft but confident as she pointed to the corner near the windows.
ex.t: 她指着靠近窗户的角落，声音轻柔却充满自信。

ex.s: Vinnie wanted to choose the corner near the windows to ______. （    ）
ex.t: Vinnie想选择靠近窗户的角落来______。（    ）

ex.s: Hospital patients Who see tree branches out their window are likely to recover at a faster rate than patients who see buildings or sky instead.
ex.src: 2019全国I卷·Is Fresh Air Really Good for You?
ex.t: 能从窗户看到树枝的医院病人康复速度可能比看到建筑物或天空的病人更快。

ex.s: After spotting a   18    on the front seat inside a parked car with its window down, he stood guard in the rain for about two hours waiting for the    19    to return.
ex.t: 在发现一辆____18____宠物狗坐在停着的车的前座上、车窗摇下后，他在雨中守候了约两小时等待____19____主人回来。

ex.s: Stay away from windows and heavy furniture.
ex.t: 远离窗户和沉重的家具。

ex.s: To celebrate the Lantern Festival, we decorate our windows with balloons and posters.
ex.t: 为了庆祝元宵节，我们用气球和海报装饰我们的窗户。

ex.s: He cleaned windows and did gardening for his family and neighbours.
ex.t: 他为家人和邻居擦窗户、做园艺。

ex.s: They rushed to the window, 30 or 40 birds all trying to _____33_____ at the same time, and pepperoni—everywhere.
ex.t: 它们冲向窗户，30或40只鸟都试图同时____33____，到处都是意大利辣香肠。

ex.s: Since our twins began learning to walk, my wife and I have kept telling them that our sliding glass door is just a window.
ex.t: 自从我们的双胞胎开始学走路，我和妻子就一直告诉他们，我们的滑动玻璃门只是一扇窗户。

ex.s: Perhaps she had been struggling against the window too long and was too tired?
ex.t: 也许她在窗户边挣扎太久，累坏了？

defs.def: 我在橱窗里看到了我想买的连衣裙。

ex.s: I looked through the window of the charming little violin shop, and my heart began to race.
ex.t: 我透过那家迷人的小提琴店的橱窗望去，心开始狂跳。

ex.s: When we look out of the window and see rain or snow, we can say “it’s raining” or “it’s snowing”.
ex.t: 当我们望向窗外看到雨或雪时，我们可以说“下雨了”或“下雪了”。

defs.def: an area within a frame on a computer screen, in which a particular program is operating or in which information of a particular type is shown （计算机屏幕的）窗口，视窗

ex.s: There is no doubt that the Bernina Express is a journey for travellers who want to get back to nature: the train window becomes the TV screen, and the natural world is the show.
ex.t: 毫无疑问，伯尔尼纳快车是想要回归自然的旅行者的一次旅程：火车车窗变成了电视屏幕，而自然世界就是节目。

defs.def: a small area of sth that you can see through, for example to talk to sb or read sth on the other side 墙上（或信封等上）开的窗形的口；透明窗口

ex.s: The best table in this two-story colonial Thai home offers a window right into the kitchen, where you can see chef Gaggan and his staff in action.
ex.t: 在这栋两层泰式殖民风格住宅中，最好的座位正对着厨房的窗口，在那里你可以看到加根主厨和他的团队在忙碌。

ex.s: The train moved on．The little boy was ____5____ awake on his mother's lap，but the woman dropped off to sleep．A moment later，he began to____6____the half-open window—one leg went over it．The man jumped up and ____7____the child just before he fell out．
ex.t: 火车继续行驶．小男孩____5____醒着坐在妈妈腿上但那位女士睡着了．片刻后他开始____6____弄半开的窗户——一条腿跨了过去．那个男人跳起来在小孩掉下去之前____7____接住了他．

ex.s: Have fun. ____40____ Read a book, knit, do a crossword puzzle, or simply watch the world unfold outside the window.
ex.t: 玩得开心。____40____读书、编织、做填字游戏，或者 simply 看窗外展开的世界。

ex.s: It’s a window to a whole new world.
ex.t: 它是通往一个全新世界的窗口。

defs.def: a way of seeing and learning about sth 了解信息的渠道；窗口
a time when there is an opportunity to do sth, although it may not last long 一丝机会；短暂的时机

ex.s: When Emily rolled down the window, Rachel asked if she was okay and told her it was not safe to stay overnight in the car.
ex.t: 当Emily摇下车窗时，Rachel问她是否还好，并告诉她整夜待在车里不安全。
